title: People’s Mañanera October 9
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Safe Digital Environments and Violence Prevention  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum presented a decree to protect children from
violent content on digital platforms. The strategy is complemented by the ABCs
of Emotions and 35,458 school assemblies aimed at preventing violence.

**Health for the People  
** The President will tour the 24 states where IMSS-Bienestar operates. She
will inspect hospitals, listen to staff, and address needs; she noted that
patient visits have increased in states that have joined the program, while in
those that have not, they remain at levels similar to those in 2023.

**National Sovereignty: A People Without Memory Has No Compass  
** “Defending sovereignty is not mere rhetoric; it is part of our history,”
stated Claudia Sheinbaum. She emphasized that the Transformation strengthens
independence through 42 million beneficiaries of Well-Being Programs, as well
as improved education, healthcare, and public infrastructure.

**Sheinbaum Mocks the MCPRIAN’s “Prominent Young People”  
** The President mocked the opposition for turning to Fox and Calderón as
their leading figures, noting that Fox promised democracy and, four Doritos
later, AMLO’s immunity was revoked. And she asked, “How can Calderón talk
about democracy when he came to power through electoral fraud?”
